analysis.question: Does the stricter route shape force the owner into worse-priced routes (more hops / fees) than run-01 accepted?
analysis.result: No. Every constraint added by setRoute rejects only configurations Curve Router NG v1.1 either never reads or reverts on: (1) non-zero entries after the first empty pool slot (InvalidRouteGap) are ignored by the router; (2) a zero executed intermediate path[2i] makes the router revert with empty data (story-007 fork pin); (3) executed swap_type == 0 reverts 'Bad swap type' (story-007 fork pin); (4) non-zero swapParams rows / pools for hops >= k are never read. Hop count bound (5) and executed-hop pools/i/j/pool_type/n_coins are unchanged and unconstrained. Hence the set of executable, economically distinct routes accepted is identical to run-01's set minus routes that would strand value (M-01) or revert; no price-relevant route is excluded. The shipped MainnetRoutes (usdeRoute k=2, dolaRoute k=1, trailing slots/rows zero) pass unchanged, and the cheaper direct 1-hop USDe->USDC route suggested in Q-05 remains registrable. Only residual over-acceptance is swap_type >= 9 (stored, reverts every harvest) — already CODE-02-001 (qa); not duplicated.

analysis.question: Does M-01's fix change the value-flow invariant 'harvester holds no balances between calls'?
analysis.result: It strengthens it. With the delivered token now provably path[2k] == sya.rewardToken() and no zero intermediates, Router NG forwards each hop's full output, so a route can no longer leave an intermediate token on the harvester. The remaining ways the invariant is violated are untouched by the diff and remain ledger entries: Q-02 (V4 exact-input partial fill leaves reward token), L-01 (raw-balance dust/donation), Q-03 (strays swept to next caller / no rescue). No new residual introduced: setRoute is owner-only config with no runtime value flow, and validation reads sya.rewardToken() at set time exactly as before (L-03 root unchanged).

analysis.question: Rounding / cross-contract value-flow changes
analysis.result: None. The diff contains no arithmetic on value; the rounding checklist rows are unaffected. Run-01 conclusions (borrow = calculateClaimAmount*101/100 headroom, settlement, ethOut gas check) are unchanged code.

analysis.question: Owner footgun introduced by the validator?
analysis.result: None found. Failures are loud at set time with indexed custom errors now decoded by harvest.sh; a competent owner using curve-js/Router NG tooling output (zero-padded) is not surprised. Contract is not deployed (registered-projects deployedAddress null), so no legacy stored routes escape the new validation.
